name: aws-waf-rules-reviewer
description: Review, audit, evaluate, or analyze AWS WAF Web ACL rules for security issues, misconfigurations, and optimization opportunities. Exclusively for existing AWS WAF configurations (Web ACL JSON exports). Does NOT handle Cloudflare, other WAF vendors, migration, or conversion tasks. Triggers on: WAF review, WAF audit, WAF rules analysis, WAF 规则评审, WAF 规则审查, WAF 配置评估, WAF 规则分析. User provides a WAF JSON file or directory path.
